lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's eighty-one? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 81? Nope!

lines.text: Whole-number sides. A circle of radius four inside touches six from A.
lines.caption: Whole-number sides. A circle of radius 4 inside touches 6 from A.

lines.text: Equal tangent pieces: six, y, and z.
lines.caption: Equal tangent pieces: 6, y, and z.

lines.text: Area two ways gives z equals eight y plus forty-eight, over three y minus eight.
lines.caption: Area two ways gives z = (8y+48) / (3y−8).

lines.text: For a positive bottom, y must be at least three.
lines.caption: For a positive bottom, y must be at least 3.

lines.text: At y equals three, z is seventy-two!
lines.caption: At y = 3, z is 72!

lines.text: Nine, seventy-five, seventy-eight: that's one hundred sixty-two!
lines.caption: 9, 75, 78: that's 162!

lines.text: Eighty-one was the trap: only half!
lines.caption: 81 was the trap: only half!

lines.text: Did you get one hundred sixty-two? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 162? Tell me below!
